decision: authorized engineering; full Resume cannot yet be certified within only the three proposed modules; retain guards until a coordinated durable prewrite protocol is implemented and verified

scope: existing safe fail-closed behavior is retained; assessment of the remaining implementation, not a browser failure claim

findings.finding: Synchronous guards/local Undo/native hook and shared underlay writes cannot await an asynchronous IDB revocation by changing only the callee.
Existing synchronous setters are followed immediately by success/clear-draft/refresh; changing them to async requires coordinated callers.
Attachment commit requires synchronous atomic setter and rejects AsyncFunction/Promise; a durable prewrite preparation must precede its final synchronous guard/commit.
Debounced package + native equality cannot establish latest browser metadata; no existing contracted synchronous durable latch found. sessionStorage is only namespace selection, strict IDB is async.
Exact status can be bounded and read-only; UUID records are removed on close, so scalar highwater cannot prove a particular missing UUID was retired. This is a prerequisite, not complete Resume.

writerStatus: Explicit current handoff of app/space synchronous mutation entry points is not established by available historical queue or PR body; root is coordinating owner. No write authorization assumed by reviewer.
minimumNextStep: Coordinate one writer with current app/space/evidence owners for a versioned durable prewrite qualification protocol and scoped caller changes; retain unsafe guards. Integrate exact resolve and same-B metadata-only attach in that complete slice, then real lifecycle/workflow oracle.
forbiddenShortcut: Replacing native evidence with source inference
Counting status endpoint alone as complete Resume
oracles: Durable revocation held/abort/quota: no native send, metadata/history write or success UI before transaction completion; recheck ownership after awaits.
Eligible B0 plus acknowledged World-preserving metadata B1 then reload must never restore stale B0; old snapshot completion cannot re-enable eligibility.
Exact resolve leaves contexts, highwater, receipts, child processes and complete root/B data unchanged including unknown/fenced/dead states.
Successful same-B resume from real iframe/reload preserves full package/source bytes/models/drafts/references/dirty-saved and native dump with no upload/reset/loadfile/create.
Wrong session/newer B/other-tab lock/corrupt or missing package/uncertain initialization retains package/ticket/native B and blocks; do not count rejection as successful Resume.
Existing Cancel/Finish/lost-reply/retiring and newer-A immutable receipt behavior stays valid on the integrated candidate.
